deterministic_parity_corpus.deterministic_order: UTF-8 fixture id ascending; no random generation, filtering, cycling, or sampling
required_position_classes: Anhoku start position and both sides to move
every unpromoted board and hand piece type in donor and receiver roles
gold, tokin, and every promoted lance, knight, silver, bishop, and rook state
empty and maximum legal hands for both colors
check, double check, pinned donor, adjacent kings allowed by Anhoku, capture, promotion, drop, and terminal positions
positions that exercise each reachable feature row and both accumulator perspectives
required_move_transitions: donor relationship gained, lost, and changed
receiver relationship gained, lost, and changed
make and unmake round trip for every transition
required_oracles: Rust incremental prediction after every move and unmove
deterministic_parity_corpus.pass_rule: Every fixture has a stable id and expected packed bytes/features. Packing and active features match the independent oracle exactly; serialized Python and Rust full-refresh/incremental integer outputs are bit-exact for both perspectives; make/unmake restores bytes, features, accumulators, and scores exactly.

sentinel_network.construction: Generate deterministically from source code, not training: assign unique bounded integer signatures to selected feature rows, alternating signs and using asymmetric layer weights/biases so perspective swaps, row collisions, sign inversions, clipping, rounding, and byte-order errors produce distinct expected outputs.
required_patterns: one-hot positive and negative feature rows
distinct donor/receiver and black/white row signatures
values immediately below, at, and above every clamp boundary
minimum and maximum representable serialized weights without accumulator overflow
required_exports: machine-readable expected per-layer activations and final integer scores for every parity fixture
SHA-256 for generator source, metadata, checkpoint, NNUE, and expectations
sentinel_network.pass_rule: Regeneration is byte-identical and every Python integer, Rust full-refresh, Rust incremental, native, and WASM result equals the frozen expected activation trace and score exactly.

required_cases: deadline during the first root move
deadline after at least one root move but before depth 1 completes
node budget before and during the first completed iteration
terminal position with no legal move
replayed repetition history through usi-wasm-v1 position ... moves ...
native and shipped WASM Worker paths at the 100 ms target
interruption_safe_search.pass_rule: Every nonterminal search returns a legal root move that was actually searched, including interruption before a completed depth; terminal positions alone may return no move. Missing moves and unsearched emergency fallbacks are zero. Termination and interruption reasons are explicit, native/WASM results satisfy the same contract, and the frozen latency ceilings are enforced.
